title: SQL Server: governor limits on the gateway's login end a snapshot early or refuse it

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: SQL Server 2022 CU27 Developer, scaled-down limits

symptom: Query governor cost limit: error 8649 at compile on the full read; nothing ran. Resource Governor REQUEST_MAX_CPU_TIME_SEC = 1: the keyless snapshot reported COMPLETED with 3,574,695 of 10,000,000 rows and no error event.
cause: The governors limit compile cost and CPU time, not elapsed time.
fix: Remove or raise the limits for the gateway's login; count after SNAPSHOT_COMPLETED.
notes: A 50-minute elapsed-time limit can't be reproduced with these governors, so that case isn't tested.
